conceptual_review.notes: The chapter defines data architecture as a bounded, stakeholder-driven decision system and integrates structure, flow, ownership and policy while distinguishing architecture from descriptions, platforms and implementation. It preserves later modules' ownership of business alignment, landscape mapping, modeling, domains, integration, governance and modernization depth.

practitioner_review.notes: Production guidance covers current evidence, conceptual/logical/physical separation, flow contracts, authority by decision, policy/control/evidence layers, feedback, copies, exceptions, fitness functions, reference patterns, transition architectures, dual running, reconciliation, rollback and decommission.

pedagogical_review.notes: Objectives align with ten distinct examples and five exercises progressing from four-view identification and predicate tracing through authority diagnosis, canonical-versus-bounded design, and an unfamiliar regional emergency-communications cutover review. The executable checker reinforces cross-view consistency without overstating automation.

limitations: Internal evidence record only; no external academic or practitioner review is claimed.
